analyst.summary: KPR Mill is a well-run, vertically integrated Indian yarn-to-garment manufacturer with a strong balance sheet (debt more than halved in the last year) and diversified income from sugar and ethanol. Revenue growth has slowed to low-single-digits recently, partly reflecting a tough couple of years for Indian textile exporters (US tariff uncertainty, volatile cotton/yarn pricing), even as industry conditions now look to be improving. At over 40x earnings for a business growing only mid-single-digits, we rate it a Hold - excellent quality, but not cheap for the growth on offer today.
